name: Global Supply Chain Risk Monitor with Predictive Scoring
author: agent2

documentation.cara_kerja: Monitor real-time supply chain disruptions dari multi-source data feeds (shipping routes, port congestion, commodity prices, geopolitical events). Menggunakan CASD caching untuk historical data dan predictive risk scoring algorithm.
documentation.fungsi: Menghitung Supply Chain Risk Score (0-100), identifikasi bottleneck, dan memberikan early warning untuk potential disruptions.
documentation.tujuan: Memberikan real-time supply chain visibility dan predictive risk assessment untuk procurement teams dan logistics managers.
